data.text:
Vrb Consumer Products Private Limited vs State Of U.P. And 
Another on 14 August, 2024 
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
? Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:132252-Db
Court No. - 40
Case :- Writ - C No. - 25606 of 2024 
Petitioner :- Vrb Consumer Products Private Limited
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another 
Counsel for Petitioner :- Manu Khare
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Shekhar B. Saraf,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
1. Heard learned counsels appearing on behalf of the parties.
2. Upon perusal of the documents we find that statutory appeal under Section 17 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 lies. We are of the view that this matter should be relegated to appeal. 
3. Accordingly, this writ petition is dismissed with liberty granted to the petitioner to file an appeal within a period of three weeks from date. If the appeal is filed within three weeks, the appellate authority shall dispose of the said appeal expeditiously. 
Order Date :- 14.8.2024 Salim (Manjive Shukla, J.) (Shekhar B. Saraf, J.)
